accountOptional: Signing in is optional, and nothing in Hifth needs it yet.
accountLeaves: Signing in sends hifth.app two things from Apple: a number Apple makes for you, and a one-time code that lets hifth.app ask Apple to remove Hifth from your Apple account if you delete your account. Testers also send their invite code. None of these is your name or your email, and we ask Apple for neither. Only the person who runs Hifth can see what hifth.app keeps. Your marks and notes stay on this device.
accountInviteHelp: Sign-in is open to invited testers for now. Type the code you were given. It is sent to hifth.app to be checked, and kept on this device so you type it once.
accountInviteRefused: That code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
accountTooMany: Too many sign-ins were started just now. Try again in ten minutes.
accountOffline: There is no connection. Try again when you are online.
accountFailed: Signing in did not work. Try again, or tell us with “Report a problem” below.
accountSignedIn: You are signed in on this device.
accountHeld: hifth.app keeps a number Apple makes for you, an account number of our own, the date your account was made, when each of your devices signed in, and, locked, a ticket from Apple used only to remove Hifth from your Apple account when you delete yours. It keeps no name, no email and no invite code.
accountHeldNoMarks: It keeps none of your marks or notes.
accountSignOutFailed: Signing out did not work. Try again.
accountDeleteAsk: Delete your account? Everything hifth.app keeps about you is deleted, and every device is signed out. The marks and notes on this device are not touched.
accountDeletedCut: Your account is deleted, and Apple has removed Hifth from your Apple account.
accountDeletedLeft: Your account is deleted. Apple could not be reached to remove Hifth on its side. To do it yourself, open Settings, tap your name, then “Sign in with Apple”, choose Hifth and remove it.
accountDeleteSignedOut: This device was no longer signed in, so nothing was deleted from here. Sign in again, then delete your account.
accountDeleteOffline: There is no connection, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you are online.
accountDeleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted just now. Try again, or write to us from “Help and support” below.
accountInviteKept: This device keeps your invite code, so you do not type it again.
accountCopyLeaves: Keeping a copy sends every mark, note and marked mistake on this device to hifth.app and puts them together with the copy already there, so each device you sign in on can have them all. The copy is not locked: the person who runs Hifth could read it. Nobody else can. You can delete it here at any time.
accountCopyKeep: Keep a copy of my marks on hifth.app
accountCopyKept: It also keeps a copy of your marks and notes, last kept {dayText}.
accountCopyDone: A copy of your marks is kept on hifth.app, and this device now has every mark in it.
accountCopyBusy: Another of your devices was keeping a copy at the same moment. Try again.
accountCopyTooBig: There are more marks than hifth.app keeps in one copy. Save them to a file instead.
accountCopySignedOut: This device was no longer signed in, so no copy was kept. Sign in again, then try once more.
accountCopyFailed: The copy could not be kept just now. Try again, or tell us with “Report a problem” below.
accountCopyDropAsk: Delete the copy of your marks on hifth.app? Your account stays, and the marks on this device are not touched.
accountCopyDropped: The copy on hifth.app is deleted. The marks on this device are not touched.
accountCopyDropSignedOut: This device was no longer signed in, so the copy was not deleted. Sign in again, then delete it.
accountCopyDropFailed: The copy could not be deleted just now. Try again, or write to us from “Help and support” below.
